title: Republic Act No. 11232 - Revised Corporation Code of the Philippines, Sec. 24 (Corporate Officers); Sec. 12 (no minimum capital stock)
claim: Every Philippine corporation must have a treasurer who is a resident and a corporate secretary who is a citizen and resident of the Philippines; stock corporations have no minimum capital stock unless a special law provides otherwise.
excerpt: a treasurer, who must be a resident ... a secretary, who must be a citizen and resident of the Philippines
limitations: Mirror site, not the Official Gazette; does not address nominee-officer practice or cost.

title: D.O. 174 does not apply to technology-enabled services involving an entire or specific business process
claim: DOLE Department Circular 1-17 excludes from DO 174 (contracting/subcontracting rules) 'information technology-enabled services involving an entire or specific business process' (BPO/KPO/LPO); DO 174 applies to trilateral contracting arrangements and requires contractor registration.
excerpt: information technology-enabled services involving an entire or specific business process
limitations: Law-firm commentary, 2017; whether a client-directed dedicated seat is an 'entire or specific business process' or trilateral manpower supply is not addressed; any later DOLE issuances not checked.

title: Littler Global Guide - Philippines - Q2 2017
claim: DO 174-17 prohibits labor-only contracting (the principal is deemed the direct employer of the contractor's employees) and increased the paid-up capital and registration-fee requirements for contractors; DC 1-17 excludes IT-enabled BPO/KPO services.
excerpt: increased requirement for paid-up capital and registration fee for contractors and subcontractors
limitations: Does not state the capital amount or fee; 2017 commentary; applicability to a foreign-principal staff-leasing model requires Philippine counsel.

title: How to Register a Foreign-Owned Export Enterprise in the Philippines (SEC, BOI/PEZA, Tax Incentives)
claim: Registration runs SEC (1-2 weeks) then BOI (1-2 months) then BIR, LGU, SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG and DOLE; overall 1-3 months; SEC filing from PHP 2,000 + 1% of capital; the page is internally inconsistent on whether export enterprises need US$200k capital.
excerpt: The process typically takes 1-3 months, depending on complexity.
limitations: Undated commercial commentary; capital statements conflict with RA 11647 text (no minimum for export enterprises) and with each other; no total cost.

title: The 2026 Accountant Technology Survey
claim: Intuit survey of 725 US accounting/bookkeeping professionals (May 2026): 80% outsource at least one service (tax preparation 40%); 65% plan to increase outsourcing (63% in 2025); only 30% say AI is fully embedded, 54% use it situationally; 77% had a hiring struggle in the past 12 months.
excerpt: 65% plan to increase outsourcing, up from 63% in 2025 (paraphrase)
limitations: Vendor-sponsored; includes domestic outsourcing and bookkeepers, not offshore CPA-firm seats specifically; methodology not published in the article.

title: How Many Perm Placements Recruiters Made in 2015
claim: Poll of Top Echelon Network recruiters (whole-desk perm placements, 2015): 0-4 13.2%; 5-8 19.8%; 9-12 24.5% (modal); 13-16 13.2%; 17-20 6.6%; >20 22.6% - i.e., median roughly 9-12 placements a year for established network recruiters.
excerpt: 9-12 placements was the most popular answer (24.5%) (paraphrase)
limitations: Informal self-reported poll, ~106 respondents (inferred), self-selected established recruiters, 2015 strong market; not newcomer data.

title: The $168K Gap: Why Top-Quartile Recruiters Out-Earn the Rest
claim: Recruiterflow benchmark of 2,100+ search/recruiting firms: the average recruiter generates $168k less revenue a year than a top-quartile recruiter; top-quartile 5.21 placements per recruiter vs 1.38 for the rest (period unstated).
excerpt: The average recruiter generates $168,000 less revenue per year than a top-quartile recruiter.
limitations: ATS-vendor data; period for the placement figures not stated; absolute revenue levels not given; mixes perm and other search.
